vibe_rationale: Small, community-made women's surf and climate gathering with workshops and song circles, authentic and welcoming but tiny.
fit_notes: Women who surf, outdoors and values-led, a close match for a health brand's wellbeing story; a swimwear brand (Childe) and a portable power brand already partner on content.
